title: Classification of Galois categories by finite continuous automorphism-group sets
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The axioms must produce both full faithfulness and essential surjectivity rather than assume the category already comes from a profinite group. The proof realizes equivariant maps as graphs of connected components and constructs every coset object by a quotient of a Galois object whose stabilizer lies in the prescribed open subgroup.
